summary: Twelve-metre kerb on a busy road, homes 12 m away, steep.
reasons: Only 12 m, one tight van length

drivers.seclusion: Residential blocks 12 m and 13 m away on the same side, more homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb on a busy two-way road; a car is already parked here and driveways bound both ends.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb here, but it is a short gap between driveways.

sun_shade: Small trees shade the verge behind; kerb open to the north.

best_section.where: South kerb of Finney Road between two driveways
